brief: A door chime that plays a tone when the door opens

input.message: A door-opening sensor, such as a magnetic reed switch, is missing from the catalog, so I can’t build a chime triggered by the door opening.
input.closest: The closest buildable option is a USB-powered chime triggered by pressing the rotary encoder’s button, using custom firmware.
input.closest_brief: Build a USB-powered chime that plays a short tone on a piezo when I press the rotary encoder’s button.
